status: Implemented pre-filing rate-model subset; no eligibility or tax-return certification
arithmetic: Exact represented rational inputs and liabilities BEFORE statutory whole-leu, per-payment, withholding and return rounding; display rounding is separate

models.arguments: Annual single-source real-system receipts, eligible expenses excluding social contributions, year, optional CAS exemption flag, optional CASS floor-exception flag
models.scope: Minimum mandatory CAS; no other independent/IP/sports income, norm regime, losses carried forward, foreign credits or voluntary contributions. Floor exception removes only top-up. The floor top-up is not income-tax deductible. Negative/zero profit has no mandatory contributions in this profile.

models.arguments: One eligible Article 53 quarter base or list of up to four quarter bases in RON, declared annual linked-group turnover in statutory EUR equivalent, year
models.scope: Eligibility including employment, ownership, filings and exclusions is asserted. Caller prepares statutory prior-year-end EUR valuation. Computes company tax only; no inferred distributable profit, dividends, payroll, credits or threshold-exit/profit-tax switch.

models.arguments: Gross dividend or complete list of gross distributions, year
models.scope: Romanian resident individual; distributed and paid in 2026, excluding interim 2025 distributions, foreign credits and exempt corporate recipients. Cash output is after income tax BEFORE aggregated CASS. Dividend CASS basis ordinarily uses paid dividends less withholding.

models.arguments: Annual net gain or signed current-year gain/loss list in one homogeneous eligible source/country pool, year, optional declared valid carryforward loss
models.scope: Annual non-withholding regime, including investment gold; no cross-country pooling, lot matching, legacy-loss expiry/order, foreign credits or qualifying-intermediary treatment. CASS is separate and uses the applicable gain basis before prior-loss carryforward.

models.arguments: Cost-adjusted realized gain/loss list, holding-day scalar/list for tax, explicit year
models.scope: Qualifying Article 96.1 intermediary; positive gains only, no tax loss netting. Caller supplies correct lot/FIFO gains and holding-day classification. Gains helper is not a tax. No automatic CASS or lot/valuation inference.

models.arguments: Complete annual signed cost-adjusted realized transaction gains, year
models.scope: Positive gains without loss netting; small-gain relief applies only when complete annual positive gains total at most 600. No cost basis, lot matching, currency valuation or automatic investment CASS assessment.

models.arguments: One annual aggregate or list of prepared nonnegative Article 155(c–h)/170 assessment amounts, year
models.scope: Apply once to the complete eligible annual assessment, not once per category. PFA CASS is separate. Caller prepares each category's statutory basis and exemptions; no prior payments, foreign credits, dividend timing or eligibility inference.

openGates: Full eligibility, multiple independent sources, carryforward expiry/order and foreign credits
Tax-basis/lot and BNR currency valuation preparation
